AARTIPHARM.technical: Emerging from a double bottom consolidation with price trading above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Neckline trigger at 1048.3 shows firm MACD momentum above zero with constructive volume accumulation.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Strong CDMO order wins drove revenue to 613 crore with operating profit margins expanding to 22.2%. ROCE stands near 18%, while debt remains serviceable amid active capex.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Fails on a decisive violation below 963.18 swing support; cut losses immediately if the neckline false-breaks.

ABDL.technical: Forming a 14% deep rounded cup with a 2.5% handle above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Pivot entry rests at 855.55 with positive MACD confirmation.
ABDL.fundamental: Topline expanded 16% YoY to 1,148 crore, but EPS growth trails the CANSLIM 25% benchmark. ROCE is 18.4% with operating margins steady around 13%.
ABDL.risk: Setup is invalidated on a breach below handle support at 795.67; exit immediately on volume breakdown.

ADANIENSOL.technical: Textbook Stage 2 trend with moving averages in proper bullish alignment. Price sits within 1.5% of the 1638.64 pivot, supported by heavy 2.33x volume and bullish MACD.
ADANIENSOL.fundamental: Consolidated net profit more than doubled to 1,364 crore on 51% revenue growth driven by transmission commissioning. High debt load typical of capital-heavy utility assets remains the chief headwind.
ADANIENSOL.risk: Thesis invalidates below the 1553.47 swing shelf; apply strict Minervini stop discipline without hesitation.

AGARWALEYE.technical: Constructing a double bottom base above 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA with neckline tension at 572.47. Recent session showed strong demand absorption off swing support.
AGARWALEYE.fundamental: Q2 net profit jumped 84% on 31% sales growth via clinic additions. Balance sheet is virtually debt-free with 20% operating margin, though high valuation tempers institutional aggression.
AGARWALEYE.risk: Fails if price violates the 529.94 swing low floor; execute stop to protect capital.

AJAXENGG.technical: High-volume 20-day high breakout past 620.52 on 16.01x volume surge. Price is extended from moving average cluster but maintains clean alignment above 21, 50, and 200 SMAs.
AJAXENGG.fundamental: PAT rose 30% YoY with excellent ROCE of 24% and virtually zero debt. Topline expansion of 9% falls short of CANSLIM's 15% standard, limiting full leadership qualification.
AJAXENGG.risk: Breakout fails if price closes below the 579.93 pivot level; cut the position immediately.

ALICON.technical: Clearing double bottom neckline resistance at 1019.02 with RSI at 71 confirming strong momentum. Well-positioned above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA.
ALICON.fundamental: Record revenue of 652 crore rose 50% YoY, but PAT growth decelerated from 97% to 27% due to raw material margin compression. Under CANSLIM rules, decelerating profit caps rating at Watch.
ALICON.risk: Invalidated on a close below 925.93 base support; enforce prompt loss-cutting discipline.
